vocabularyUsageNote.nl:
This attribute specifies the type of coupling of a fire hydrant outlet.
Commonly used outlet types include DSP and Storz.The outlet type is not modelled as a closed codelist because the set of possible outlet connections is not guaranteed to be exhaustive.
